_comment: The BPO film. Ranges chosen by reading the takes frame by frame (journal 2026-09-23). The fill runs 10x under an elapsed counter driven by SOURCE time. Phone shots are B-roll cutaways, NOT synced (journal). Ends on the animated checklist card.

take1._bg_why: Cursorful's backdrop, sampled at the frame edge; the 1064-line frame is padded to 1080 with it so no seam shows

paint._why: tab strip: tab titles and window controls, erased to the strip's own colour
address bar: C:/Users/<user>/Downloads/... is a local path with the user name in it
eight tabs all titled 'untitled' -- reads as a debugging session
local file path with the user name
PDF viewer title 'untitled' -- the synthetic listings have no document title

take3._note: takes 3 and 4 were recorded as one file; Submit is at 58.00, the result message at 168.88 (measured to the frame)

blur._why: 'processed in 1 minute and 28 seconds' is the server's interval; the counter shows click-to-result (1:50) and the two must not sit side by side disagreeing

phone._rotate_why: no rotation tag, and the picture is upside down: keyboard legends and the mousepad print read inverted

edl._why: the blank form: 2.5 s on page 1, the scroll, then section III held -- the grid the film is about
on to page 3; skips 0:21-0:27 where the zoom-out made page 2 unreadable
the eight documents; the first 8.5 s sat on one tab
scene break: a hand at the keyboard, before the tool appears (B-roll)
Instafill: landing, dashboard, choosing the blank BPO
form loaded, the eight documents chosen and listed
the cursor to Submit; drops 11 s of hovering
cutaway #1: the click (B-roll from the take-5 session -- the phone was not rolling during take 3)
Submit fires at 58.00 -- the counter starts
the fill, 107.5 s at 10x under the counter
done -- the counter stops on the result message
the filled form appears; drops 11 s of 'File is loading'
download: enters on Cursorful's zoom (the first download, end of take3, is the duplicate)
cutaway #2: a click, covering the dark flash while the PDF opens (take5 8.7-10.0)
the downloaded PDF, the comps grid, the $392,000 check against the listing, section VI; ends before section VII (empty estimated values)
end card: what the film showed, ticking in line by line, then the logo (user chose the 'window' look with the logo)

counters.label: AI filling the form
counters._why: Submit click to the result message, measured to the frame: 110.9 s

zooms._why: the promise, 'The AI does the paperwork. Not you.' -- the line the voice-over opens the tool on

the eight documents and Submit, framed below the yellow '8 files increases the chance of errors' banner. Starts at 39.7 so it is fully in before the list (and the banner) appear at 40.6. Holds across the hover cut, ends on the cut to the phone
back from the phone on Submit, at 1.6x not 1.95x so Submit sits above the counter card; ends on a hard cut to the progress screen (61.3) -- an ease-out showed the banner again
the reveal: a slow push onto the fields that just filled (address, parcel, market conditions)

audio._why: voice: ElevenLabs brian (the channel voice since flatten-pdf) from vo/film.json. Music: the user chose the YouTube Audio Library; set music to the downloaded file and re-render -- it loops, fades and ducks under the voice.

captions._why: style C, the user's choice: one line in the lavender band under the window, in the counter card's colour

display._why: the voice spells numbers out; the caption shows them the way the picture does
